evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's member profile from the member ID on his card.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole exception history: the 2025 Rinvoq approval (expired 2026-09-17), the August 2026 Rinvoq renewal denied for alternatives not tried, the expedited Rinvoq request and statement of 2026-10-06, the Ubrelvy requests (denied March, pending since September) and the pending Breztri tier request.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the plan enrollment under the member's sponsor: Northbridge Rx Value, active, plan year starting 2026-01-01.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The plan year start date sets the starting period of the Ubrelvy approval (three months left in the plan year).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the review package: Northbridge Clinical Advanced.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Its prior-authorization and quantity-limit lists and decision hours decide the first-approval and quantity-limit shortenings and the prior-authorization wait of the external review.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Rinvoq prior-authorization case of 2025.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the home delivery account (Northbridge Home Delivery Standard).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Context for the Breztri home delivery shipments counted in the stable-use credit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Breztri prescription on file at home delivery.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Breztri home delivery orders: three shipments in 2026 (January, April, July).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Three shipments within the stable lookback put the stable-use credit on its top tier.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the payments against the Breztri orders.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the home delivery account carries no balance; the orders were paid.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Rinvoq enrollment under Northbridge Specialty Care Management and its prescriber.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Rinvoq shipments (latest 2026-09-15, 30 days, to home; 12 shipments in the last 12 months) and the 2026-07-17 missed-delivery reshipment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The latest shipment sets the days left and the on-hand supply; the count sets the established-therapy credit; the reshipment sets the delivery-failure reserve.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the specialty payments against the Rinvoq shipments.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms no specialty balance is due.

user_scenario:
You are Ignatius Ferreira-Holmqvist, fifty-two, a high-school chemistry teacher in Lakewood, Ohio, covered through the Cuyahoga Lakeshore Teachers Health Cooperative. You are brisk and a little wry, you call from the teachers' lounge between classes, and you like to get to the point. Your rheumatoid arthritis medicine is Rinvoq, which the specialty pharmacy mails to you every month. Your new rheumatologist sent Northbridge Rx an urgent coverage request for it on Tuesday afternoon, and when you called the specialty pharmacy this morning they said nothing has been approved, so they cannot ship. You have about a week of pills left. What you want is for that urgent Rinvoq request to be dealt with today so the pharmacy can send your next supply.

When the representative asks who you are, you give your member ID, NBX362904817, and then your date of birth, 1974-06-19. If they want more you can add your phone number, 216-555-0152, or your ZIP code, 44107. You do not know internal reference numbers or any doctor's NPI number.

You know your old rheumatologist's renewal request for Rinvoq was turned down back in August, which is why the new doctor sent the urgent one; you mention the August denial only if they ask about earlier requests. If they ask whether you have anything else waiting, you remember that your neurologist sent a request for your migraine tablets, Ubrelvy, and your lung doctor sent one about the price tier of your Breztri inhaler, both in late September, and that you have heard nothing on either. If the representative says those have to be decided first, you tell them to go ahead.

If the representative explains that you can ask for an independent review of the August denial and that they need to know whether you want one, you say yes, you want the independent review, and if they hand it to you to submit you do it with exactly the details they read out and read back the confirmation. You leave it to them how urgently it should be handled.

Once the representative tells you the Rinvoq approval has been recorded and how long it lasts, you thank them and hang up. If a figure they give sounds odd you only ask them to double-check it against your records; you never propose a number or tell them what to do next.

edges.policy_source: An expedited approval's period is fixed only after the member has said whether they want an independent review of every earlier denial of the same drug.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: N1 before T1 is fixed by the tier rule's prerequisite sentence, and both before E1 by the expedited rule's two queue sentences. The member's review request (U1) is free relative to N1 and T1: its computation reads only specialty, review and appeal records, never formulary_exceptions, and N1 and T1 read approved, denied and statement rows but never external review requests. Replaying the gold with U1 moved ahead of N1 (order U1, N1, T1, E1) gives the same values (expedited, 7, 16, 52) and the same terminal rows, since each row id hashes only its own call's arguments.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the member's review request no external review is pending, the review bridge is 0 and approval_days becomes 50 instead of 52 (expiration 2026-11-26 instead of 2026-11-28); the terminal state also lacks the review request row.

Skipping the tier decision leaves the Breztri request undecided: approval_days stays 52, but the terminal formulary_exceptions lacks the Breztri tier-2 approval running to 2028-02-07 and the expedited approval would be recorded out of queue order.

Skipping the Ubrelvy decision leaves it undecided: the terminal state lacks the Ubrelvy tier-3 approval running to 2027-05-07 and, through the tier edge, the tier approval becomes 21 months instead of 16.
Without the Ubrelvy approval no approval is in force at the tier decision, the starting tier period falls back to the standard 12 months and approval_months becomes 21 instead of 16.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the urgent Rinvoq request to be dealt with. The Ubrelvy and Breztri requests come up only if the representative asks whether anything else is waiting, the August denial only if asked about earlier requests, and the independent review only as a yes after the representative explains it; nothing in the persona says that anything has to happen first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: approve_expedited_exception_8cc2ac55 looks up only the request and the assignment to copy the strength, prescriber and member, then creates the approval row; it never checks for pending earlier requests or for an external review request and returns the same 'approved' receipt either way. approve_tier_exception_8a527f11 never checks for other approvals, and request_external_exception_review_e71b5dce creates the review row without checking the denial.

factor_trace: plan_year_starting_period (method, cross-difficulty plan): plan year start 2026-01-01, MONTHS(2026-01-01, 2026-10-08) = 9, so 12 - 9 = 3 months remain, at most the tail-quarter 3 -> run to the end of the next plan year: 3 + 12 = 15; baseline (standard 12) gives 4.

first_approval_shortening (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty review): no approval of a Ubrelvy exception on record AND Ubrelvy is on the Clinical Advanced prior-authorization list -> 6 off; baseline 0 gives 13.

recent_denial_shortening (parameter): the Ubrelvy request of 2026-03-02 was denied 2026-03-06 for alternatives not tried, 7 whole months back, inside the 12-month lookback -> 3 off; baseline 0 gives 10.

alternative_trial_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty retail): sumatriptan 150 days (5 fills from 2026-05-20) and Nurtec ODT 60 days (2026-06-25, 2026-07-28; the 2026-03-10 fill is 6 whole months back and outside the lookback) each reach the 30-day minimum, so 2 alternatives tried = the Value Formulary's required 2 -> exact-trial credit +1; baseline 0 gives 6.
quantity_limit_review_shortening (parameter, cross-difficulty review): Ubrelvy is on the Clinical Advanced quantity-limit list and on its prior-authorization list -> 2 off; baseline 0 gives 9.

late_nf_decision_credit (parameter): latest Ubrelvy statement 2026-09-25, due 72 h / 24 = 3 days later; DAYS(2026-09-25, 2026-10-08) - 3 = 10 days late, at least the 7 late-week days -> +2; baseline 0 gives 5.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (formulary_exceptions_and_transition)

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 4, 6]}. Taken: standard non-formulary approval 6 factors, tier exception approval 5, member's external review request priority 4, expedited approval 6 (multiset = draw). Occupied by task 0: the three transition-supply policies and the member-opened exception request with their four tools. Claimed here, disjoint: the decision side (standard non-formulary approval, tier exception approval, expedited approval — split by tool because the base charter fixes standard approvals in calendar months and expedited approvals in days, and tier versus non-formulary exceptions run under different base policies) and the member's own external review request. Together the two tasks cover all eight extended policies; no policy or tool is left idle.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. Surface goal: 'that urgent Rinvoq request to be dealt with today'. Core scored value: the length in days of the expedited Rinvoq approval (52). Before it can be recorded the agent must read three prerequisite sentences in the expedited rule: (a) the period waits on the member's election about independent review of every earlier denial of Rinvoq — the August renewal denial exists, the member says yes and submits it, and that review's priority is itself a 4-factor computation (expedited) that sets a 2-day bridge; (b) the approval is not recorded until every earlier-due tier exception request has a decision — the Breztri request, due 2026-10-03; (c) likewise every earlier-due standard non-formulary request — Ubrelvy, due 2026-09-28. The tier approval in turn is fixed only after earlier-due non-formulary requests are decided, because its period aligns to the approval in force (Ubrelvy's), so the order is Ubrelvy -> Breztri -> (review) -> Rinvoq. Breadth: 21 factors over the formulary exception history (15 rows), plan year, review package lists and authorizations, retail alternative-trial fills, home delivery shipments, specialty shipments and reshipments, and the appeal program's external review terms.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root E = formulary_ext_expedited_approval_days (approve_expedited_exception_8cc2ac55, agent).
 E -> U (formulary_ext_external_review_priority, request_external_exception_review_e71b5dce, owner=user): value_input, gate review_bridge, form ACTION. Sentence (affirmative): 'An expedited approval's period is fixed only after the member has said whether they want an independent review of every earlier denial of the same drug.' fallback_reason: a member who declines review leaves no record, so no record-visible state separates 'declined' from 'not yet asked'. Opening: the 2026-08-24 denial of request 22d1198e-36b2-4f19-97f0-b56aa19d0d01 exists and no external review request is on file. Effect: bridge 0 -> 2 (52 vs 50).
 E -> T (formulary_ext_tier_approval_months, approve_tier_exception_8a527f11, agent): state_gate, gate formulary_exceptions.event_type, state form, negated: 'An expedited approval is not recorded until every tier exception request of the member whose decision fell due earlier than the expedited request carries a decision on record.' Only the tier approval tool records a decision on a tier request in this difficulty. Opening: Breztri request 78c7f946-9ff0-42ae-9b18-79ed9b006135 has a statement (2026-09-30 11:20, due 2026-10-03) and no decision.
 E -> N (formulary_ext_standard_nf_approval_months, approve_standard_nonformulary_exception_57f550b5, agent): state_gate, negated: 'An expedited approval is not recorded until every standard non-formulary exception request of the member whose decision fell due earlier than the expedited request carries a decision on record.' Opening: Ubrelvy request 19741851-85f7-459f-a911-491f683887a7 statement 2026-09-25 10:00 (due 2026-09-28), undecided.
 T -> N: value_input, gate tier_period, state form, affirmative: 'A tier exception approval's period is fixed only after every non-formulary exception request of the member that fell due earlier than the tier exception request carries a decision on record.' Deciding Ubrelvy puts an approval in force (to 2027-05-07) that the tier period aligns to: 7 instead of 12 months, so 16 instead of 21.
 Four-point test held for each sentence (ordering connective 'only after' / 'not ... until'; a record-visible decision entry or, for E->U, a plainly named member election; no tool, id or code token; scope 'every ... whose decision fell due earlier'). Topological order N, T, U, E (gold steps 20, 22, 24, 26); U commutes with N and T (verified: U, N, T, E gives expedited, 7, 16, 52). value_input edges: E->U and T->N = 2 >= max(3-1, 1). Deletion runs: skip U -> E 50; skip N -> T 21; skip T -> E unchanged 52 but the Breztri approval row is missing; skip N -> the Ubrelvy approval row is missing and T becomes 21.

3. FACTOR CARD (tier / evidence / single-factor baseline result).
 Ubrelvy approval (7, all-baseline 12): plan_year_starting_period [M, x-plan] 3 months left -> 3 + 12 = 15 (->4); first_approval_shortening [P, multi-source, x-review] no prior approval AND PA-listed -> -6 (->13); recent_denial_shortening [P] March denial for alternatives not tried -> -3 (->10); alternative_trial_credit [P, x-retail] 2 alternatives = required -> +1 (->6; near-miss: the 2026-03-10 Nurtec fill is outside the 6-month lookback); quantity_limit_review_shortening [P, x-review] QL- and PA-listed -> -2 (->9); late_nf_decision_credit [P] 10 days late -> +2 (->5).
 Breztri approval (16, all-baseline 12): renewal_alignment_period [M] Ubrelvy approval to 2027-05-07 -> 7 (->21; near-miss: the 2025 Rinvoq approval expired 2026-09-17 is not in force); home_delivery_stable_use_credit [P, x-mail] 3 shipments -> +3 (->13); preferred_alternative_trial_credit [P, x-retail] 2 Trelegy fills -> +2 (->14); clinical_ground_credit [P] adverse effect -> +3 (->13); late_tier_decision_credit [P] 5 days late -> +1 (->15).
 Review priority (expedited, all-baseline standard): review_delivery_failure_reserve [P, x-specialty] missed-delivery reship 2026-07-17 -> 1 off; review_prior_authorization_wait [P, x-review] Rinvoq PA expired 2026-09-19 -> +1; review_wait_calendar [M, x-specialty] the 5 calendar days of waits end Tuesday 2026-10-13; Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy ships Monday through Friday, so the 2-business-day scheduling lead runs to Thursday 2026-10-15 = 7 days; review_effectuation_wait [P, x-appeal] 24 h -> +1. 7 - 1 = 6 < 7 expedited; each baseline alone gives standard (7 vs 7, 6 vs 6, 6 vs 5, 6 vs 6).
 Rinvoq approval (52, all-baseline 30): pending_review_bridge [P] +2 (->50); exigency_onhand_supply [M, x-specialty] +7 (->45); late_expedited_decision_allowance [P] +1 (->51); appeal_route_allowance [P, x-appeal] concurrent external review -> +2 (->50); established_therapy_credit [P, x-specialty] 12 shipments -> +5 (->47); continuation_credit [P] 2025 approval expired 0 months ago -> +5 (->47).

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Approvals (subject formulary_exception_approved) inherit formulary_evt_exception_timeline.statement_before_approval (each request has its statement on file: Ubrelvy 2026-09-25, Breztri 2026-09-30, Rinvoq 2026-10-06 16:30) and decide_once (none of the three requests carries an approval, denial or withdrawal); formulary_tier_exception, formulary_nonformulary_exception, formulary_evt_exception_duration and formulary_external_exception_review govern the subject without a gate on approvals (policy_scope). Approved tiers follow base: non-formulary brand '3', specialty '4', tier exception 3 -> '2'. Overwrite declared on formulary_evt_exception_duration: the 12-month standard length (Ubrelvy, Breztri) and the 30-day expedited length (Rinvoq) are replaced by the computed periods; expiration conventions (day before the same day-of-month; decision date as day 1) are kept and implemented by the tools. The external review request inherits formulary_external_exception_review.review_only_after_denial (latest decision on 22d1198e-36b2-4f19-97f0-b56aa19d0d01 is the 2026-08-24 denial). No time gate applies to these writes.

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Holding: Value Formulary assignment f9320e79-3618-4da6-a14d-a391265bb48f. Objects: Ubrelvy request 19741851-85f7-459f-a911-491f683887a7 (not the denied March request d0d2a5b2-5a9a-4bdc-a8e1-2eef63725932); Breztri request 78c7f946-9ff0-42ae-9b18-79ed9b006135; Rinvoq expedited request eb579ded-cb4e-428b-9858-67ff68b82c11 (not the denied August request 22d1198e-36b2-4f19-97f0-b56aa19d0d01, which is the object of the review, nor the 2025 request 7ca75209-8fbd-4d31-aa4c-f2df5ea509e2, approved and expired). Alternative-trial rows: sumatriptan and Nurtec ODT retail fills; Trelegy Ellipta fills. Supply rows: latest Rinvoq shipment 2026-09-15.

6. SEED. 15 exception rows across three drugs, 12 Rinvoq shipments + 1 reshipment with scheduled rows and member payments until the out-of-pocket maximum was reached, 3 Breztri home delivery orders with payments, 10 retail fills, 17 plan-year accumulator postings that sum to deductible_met 200.00 and oop_met 3600.00 (the plan's maximums), the expired Rinvoq prior authorization with its case, the appeal program. Three requests are overdue (backlog), which is why the queue rule bites; none of the open statuses ignites an obligation outside this task.

7. PERSONA. Ignatius Ferreira-Holmqvist, brisk and wry, calling from school. Volunteered: the urgent Rinvoq request sent Tuesday, the pharmacy cannot ship, a week of pills left. On request: member ID NBX362904817, DOB 1974-06-19, phone, ZIP; the August denial; the Ubrelvy and Breztri requests. Reactions: lets the others be decided first; says yes to independent review and submits it with the values read to him; ends when told the Rinvoq approval and its length. He never names a priority, a tier or a number.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION (27 actions). find_customers(member_number) -> verify (DOB + member ID) -> read assignment, exceptions, plan enrollment and accumulator ledger, review program/cases/authorizations, retail benefit/claims, mail account/prescriptions/orders/payments, specialty enrollment/fills/ledger, appeal program -> approve Ubrelvy (tier 3, 7 months) -> approve Breztri (tier 2, 16 months) -> member submits expedited review of request 22d1198e-36b2-4f19-97f0-b56aa19d0d01 -> approve Rinvoq expedited (non_formulary_exception, tier 4, 52 days).

9. VERIFICATION RUN. The authoring replay (handling-time evaluation with the real tools): Ubrelvy 7 (factor baselines 4/13/10/6/9/5, all 12); Breztri 16 (21/13/14/13/15, all 12); review expedited (all standard); Rinvoq 52 (50/45/51/50/47/47, all 30); skip runs T without N 21, E without U 50, E without T 52, E without N 52. check_compute --task 1: COMPUTE OK.

10. CLOSURE. charter_scope = required_documents = [Ubrelvy approval, Breztri approval, review priority, Rinvoq expedited approval]; computations at steps 20/22/24/26; writes follow the topological order; solvability_contract cites the statements and decisions on record for every gate (check_solvability OK). Draft recomputation from the visible context (KB prose, finder returns, tool schemas, persona) reproduces the order and the four values; the judgement-heavy points are the queue order by due time and the alignment of the tier period to the approval just booked.

11. ROUND-2 REVISIONS (policy-task audit). D-F2: review_dispensing_wait only put a number into the review total although it was labelled method; it is replaced by review_wait_calendar, a genuine day-count method (Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy: the summed review, prior-authorization and effectuation waits plus the scheduling lead are business days converted to calendar days; retail: calendar days plus pickup; otherwise calendar days as they are). To keep every factor pivotal the latest Rinvoq shipment moved from 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-17 (9 days left), the 2025 approval now runs 2025-09-18 to 2026-09-17 (covering that shipment) and the Rinvoq prior authorization 2025-09-20 to 2026-09-19 (it covered every Rinvoq shipment and is expired at the call); the root moved from 52 to 54 days and every dependent figure was re-run. O3: the tier policy's rule now opens on tier requests decided on the standard timeframe, so an expedited tier approval falls only under the expedited policy. O7: the three queue sentences now name their comparator ('earlier than the tier exception request' / 'earlier than the expedited request') and the rules define a request's due time by the decision hours of its own priority; the edge conditions follow. O2: the trial-credit wording is generalised to 'the formulary alternatives in the drug's therapeutic class (for an acute-migraine drug, sumatriptan and Nurtec ODT)' and the lower-tier alternative 'in the drug's class (for a triple-therapy inhaler, Trelegy Ellipta)'. T1-O2 (the Rinvoq prior authorization has expired, so the specialty pharmacy will also need a coverage review) is context outside this difficulty; the persona closes on the approval being recorded and asks for nothing more.

12. ROUND-3 REVISIONS (R2-F2). The round-2 calendar factor treated the independent reviewer's hours, the review package's hours and the appeal program's effectuation hours as specialty-pharmacy business days, which conflicts with the base clocks. review_wait_calendar now keeps every one of those waits in its owner's unit (hours / 24 = calendar days) and applies the pharmacy calendar only to what the pharmacy itself owns: for Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy, which ships Monday through Friday, a weekend ready day moves to Monday and the program's delivery scheduling lead, defined in business days, is counted forward over weekdays; for a retail pharmacy a Sunday ready day moves to Monday and the pickup wait is added; otherwise the ready day stands. To keep each factor decisive with these honest units the latest Rinvoq shipment returns to 2026-09-15 (7 days left; the 2025 approval through 2026-09-17 and the prior authorization through 2026-09-19 still cover it); the review stays expedited (6 < 7) and the root returns to 52 days; every dependent figure was re-run and replaced.
